question: Which of the following is not a regional name for East Coast (or part of it) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Malabar coast__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Western Ghats:

 
 
• The western ghat is the mountain range parallel to the western coast of the Indian peninsula.
 
• The total length of the western ghat is around 1600 km.
 
• The western ghat region is spread from Tapti to Kanyakumari.
 
• It passes through the Indian states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Goa, Maharashtra, and Gujarat.
 
• Anamudi is the highest peak of the western ghat.
 
• All important rivers of Peninsular India originate from the western ghat.
 
• The major hill stations of the western ghat are Amboli ghat, Matheran, Mahabaleshwar, Panchgani, and Kudremukh.
 
 
 
• Eastern Ghats:
 
 
• A discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast runs parallel to the Bay of Bengal. 
 
• They are eroded and cut through by the four major rivers of peninsular India, Godavari, Mahanadi, Krishna and Kaveri. 
 
• Some of the important ranges include the Shevaroy hills, Javadi hills, the Palconda range, the Nallamala hills, the Mahendragiri hills, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• Coromandel Coast

 
 
• It is the coastal plain in eastern Tamil Nadu state.
 
• It is bounded by the Utkal Plains to the north, the Bay of Bengal to the east, and the Kaveri delta to the south and the Eastern Ghats to the west.
 
• Extending over an area of about 22,800 square kilometres.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0569a8472be1cb5fa091d0d82b41393b63f4c8f3209c4cd0d07661a9043071ec.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Coastal plains of India -

 
 
• From Gujarat to Mumbai Coast – Kathiawar Coast
 
• Coast from Mumbai to Goa – Konkan Coast
 
• The Malabar Coast is a stretch of coastline along the southwestern part of India, primarily located in the state of Kerala. It extends from the southern part of the state of Maharashtra, passes through the state of Goa, and runs along the entire length of the state of Kerala – Malabar Coast
